title: BlogStudio Base Frontmatter
description: Base fields required across all per-target frontmatter files. Per-adapter schemas extend this with target-specific fields.

slug.description: URL slug. Defaults to slugified title if omitted.

authors.description: Author byline(s). Single-author posts have one element; multi-author posts have multiple.

description.description: Short post description for SEO meta + post-list previews

draft.description: If true, excluded from build outputs

series.description: Series slug if this post is part of a series

canonical_url.description: Original URL if this post was originally published elsewhere
